title: Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation
abstract: arXiv:2608.27429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology.   We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors.   Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites. translated_title: 基于图结构电子占据的离散流匹配进行机理反应预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27429v1 公告类型：新  摘要：化学反应本质上是电子空间中的变换，然而大多数机器学习方法要么通过从头生成产物分子，要么通过直接操作分子拓扑的启发式图编辑来建模。我们引入了MAELLE（机理编辑的电子重排离散流匹配），该方法将反应建模为电子占据向量上的离散流匹配。具体来说，我们将反应物到产物的映射形式化为一个连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC），该链定义在所有成键、非键和氢位点上的图结构整数电子占据空间上。为了构建中间编辑轨迹，我们使用最优传输将离散流匹配混合路径推广到离散电子重排，从而产生一系列机理可解释的编辑步骤，而无需依赖预定义的反应规则或产物模板。
tldr: 本文提出MAELLE方法，通过离散流匹配和最优传输在电子占据空间上建模化学反应，生成机理可解释的编辑轨迹，避免了传统产物生成或启发式图编辑的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MAELLE, which models chemical reactions via discrete flow matching and optimal transport on electron occupation space, generating mechanistically interpretable edit trajectories without predefined reaction rules or product templates.
